description: This file implements a PPC64-specific stack walker for the Google Breakpad crash reporting system, including methods to retrieve context and caller stack frames.

classes.name: StackwalkerPPC64
classes.description: A class implementing PPC64-specific stack walking logic, including context and caller frame retrieval.

classes.name: StackFramePPC64
classes.description: A class representing a PPC64 stack frame, used internally within the stack walker.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current context stack frame based on the provided CPU context.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the caller's stack frame by analyzing the current stack and CPU context.
